title: Key component groups of environment nanoparticles and their corresponding contribution to oxidative stress of Escherichia coli in water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00228E, Paper
Chunlei Jiao, Tong Sun, Min Chen, Yiwei Cai, Guiying Li, Taicheng An
Environmental nanoparticles (NPs) induce oxidative stress damage in Escherichia coli, with the largest NP-components and Al species (predominantly present as γ-Al2O3) contributing the most to this damage process.
